P_0x00AFAC: The central figure of the <ATX Project>. A brilliant scientist, but a workaholic, egotistical, and jealous. Developed the Alt Eisen and Weiss Ritter; now at <Mao Industries> on a prototype.
P_0x00B0FB: Director of the <Tesla Leicht Institute>. Irm's father and Robert's former boss. A robotics authority rivaling the late Bian Zoldark. Easygoing, fond of jokes and women. Creator of the Grungust series.
P_0x00B2A0: Chief of Special Archaeology at the LTR (Lost Tech Research) Organization. Studies the ancient Chinese "<Chokijin>." Flashy in appearance but intelligent and composed. Passionate to a fault, and prone to trouble.
P_0x00B46E: A member of Project Ark (the species preservation plan) and developer of Magus, the <Earth Cradle>'s control computer. A rational realist whose looks keep others distant, but kind at heart.
P_0x00B5E2: VP of L&E Corp, which handles repairs and rescue work. A skilled engineer, indifferent to what bores her but absorbed in what interests her, often losing track of all else.
P_0x00B738: Kouta and Shouko's grandfather. Runs the Azuma Institute in Asakusa (Shouko, its accountant, is the only real staff). Hot-blooded, principled, and head of the neighborhood association. Tinkers with useless-seeming inventions, but a skilled roboticist. Meeting Roar reveals the evil targeting Earth, and he repairs the Kaiser Roar brought. Once wealthy from patents, he's spent most of his fortune on it.
